messages.content:
You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1, what is the most likely diagnosis for the 45-year-old woman with retrosternal pain and dysphagia? Consider the presence of a filling defect and the absence of mucosal abnormalities in your assessment.

A) Squamous esophageal carcinoma  
B) Adenomatous oesophagal carcinoma  
C) Leiomyosarcoma of the oesophagus  
D) Achalasia  
E) Benign leiomyoma of the oesophageal wall  
F) Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
